cases.objective: Posture check opens Posture Detection with Today's workout, My plan and the Exercise library
cases.actual: Tabs shown: Today's workout, My plan, Exercise library
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-01 Posture check opens Posture Detection with Today's workout, My plan and the Exercise library

cases.objective: Today's workout lists today's plan entries (or the rest day) from the personalised plan
cases.expected: One entry per exercise of today's plan day, or the rest-day message when today is a rest day
cases.actual: Today (weekday 6) is a rest day in the plan; rest-day message shown 1
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-02 Today's workout lists today's plan entries (or the rest day) from the personalised plan

cases.objective: My plan shows every day of the complete plan with each entry's camera capability
cases.input: Posture Detection → "My plan" → each training day
cases.expected: For every training day: its entries with a capability label
cases.actual: 6 training days checked. Full-Body Fitness: 9 entries, capability label 1; Cardio & Core: 8 entries, capability label 1; Strength Mix: 10 entries, capability label 1; Full-Body Fitness: 9 entries, capability label 1; Cardio & Core: 8 entries, capability label 1; Strength Mix: 10 entries, capability label 1
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-03 My plan shows every day of the complete plan with each entry's camera capability

cases.objective: The generic Exercise library keeps its camera and manual sections
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-04 The generic Exercise library keeps its camera and manual sections

cases.objective: A planned camera exercise opens mode selection; Continue without consent does not start the camera
cases.input: My plan → a camera-tracked planned exercise → Continue with the consent toggle off
cases.expected: Both modes and the consent switch; the consent message; no camera screen
cases.actual: Entry 0-1: modes 2, consent switch 1, consent message shown, camera screen 0
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-05 A planned camera exercise opens mode selection; Continue without consent does not start the camera

cases.objective: With consent the real camera session starts on the phone, and Stop Session ends it with a summary
cases.input: Planned camera exercise → consent on → Continue → about 8 s of live camera → "Stop Session"
cases.expected: Live camera overlay running, exercise name or setup hint, privacy notice; after Stop: "Session Summary" whose reps equal the session counter; saved in memory only
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the camera screen
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-06 With consent the real camera session starts on the phone, and Stop Session ends it with a summary

cases.objective: Manual Guidance shows the set counter, checklist and controls, and Pause stops the clock
cases.input: Planned exercise → Manual Guidance → Continue → Pause → Resume
cases.expected: "Manual Guidance", "Proper Form", "Completed ✓", "Skip", "Too Difficult"; Pause switches to "Resume" and back
cases.actual: Shown: Proper Form, Completed ✓, Skip, Too Difficult; Resume after Pause 1; Pause after Resume 1
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-07 Manual Guidance shows the set counter, checklist and controls, and Pause stops the clock

cases.objective: A refused camera permission keeps the camera off and offers Manual Guidance (denial simulated in the app, no system dialog)
cases.input: Camera permission answer "denied" (AppPermissions override); consent on → Continue → "Use Manual Guidance"
cases.expected: "Camera access needed" dialog; no camera screen; Manual Guidance opens
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for Manual Guidance
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-08 A refused camera permission keeps the camera off and offers Manual Guidance (denial simulated in the app, no system dialog)

cases.objective: An exercise the camera cannot follow says why and still offers Manual Guidance
cases.input: Exercise library → first exercise in "Manual guidance" section
cases.expected: Mode selection explains that camera detection is not available, with the reason; Manual Guidance available
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-09 An exercise the camera cannot follow says why and still offers Manual Guidance
